title: Constantly get Google Play Services error
symptom: On a phone without Google Play services, the message "com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip.xdrip won't run without Google Play services, which are not supported by your device." appears. The user expects the error to be shown only once and only when enabling the embedded master-follower feature, or to fall back to a non-Google Play services implementation.
evidence_quote: On a phone without google play services the message "com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip.xdrip won't run without Google Play services, which are not supported by your device."
